The '''Allanteen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="AOC" /> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the intersection of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]].<ref name="TEA21" /> Circa [[3956 BBY]], the [[Battle of Allanteen]] erupted in the system.<ref name="TEA130">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', 130.</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it contained a [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|shipyard]] which was used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to modify his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="WS" />

The system was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy.
